definitions.rationale: Defines the zero-depth empty-suffix base case of the named mathematical summary bracketResult.
Defines bracketResult on an empty suffix at positive depth as the unbalanced result false.
definitions.text:
rule bracketResult(.IntSeq, D:Int) => false
       requires D >Int 0
       [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Completes the total definition of bracketResult on an empty suffix at negative depth.
definitions.text:
rule bracketResult(.IntSeq, D:Int) => false
       requires D <Int 0
       [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines the recurrence for an opening bracket at depth zero by consuming it and continuing at depth one.
Defines the failure case for consuming a non-opening character when the current depth is zero.
Defines the positive-depth opening-bracket recurrence of bracketResult by incrementing the summary depth.
definitions.text:
rule bracketResult(iCons(60, REST:IntSeq), D:Int)
    => bracketResult(REST, D +Int 1)
       requires D >Int 0

definitions.rationale: Defines the positive-depth non-opening recurrence of bracketResult by decrementing the summary depth.
definitions.text:
rule bracketResult(iCons(C:Int, REST:IntSeq), D:Int)
    => bracketResult(REST, D -Int 1)
       requires notBool (C ==Int 60) andBool D >Int 0

definitions.rationale: Completes the total bracketResult definition by making a negative depth an absorbing false result.
definitions.text:
rule bracketResult(iCons(_C:Int, _REST:IntSeq), D:Int) => false
       requires D <Int 0
       [simplification]

operational_rules.rationale: Executes the program's literal-Boolean return form by setting the return state and moving to the existing #pop control state.
Executes the program-specific final depth comparison and return as a verification-model macro-step over the current scope.
operational_rules.text:
rule <k>
         Return(Compare(Name("depth"), CmpOp("==", Int(0)))) ~> _
       =>
         #pop
       </k>
       <env> L:Int </env>
       <scopes>
         ... L |-> scope(
           "brackets" |-> _BRACKETS:Val
           "depth" |-> D:Int
           "bracket" |-> _BRACKET:Val,
           _PARENT:Parent) ...
       </scopes>
       <ret> noRet => retV(D ==Int 0) </ret>
       [priority(40)]

operational_rules.rationale: Observes the current one-character bracket value and routes the program's equality test to the true #branch state.
operational_rules.text:
rule <k>
         If(Compare(Name("bracket"), CmpOp("==", Str("<"))),
            THEN:Stmts, ELSE:Stmts)
       =>
         #branch(true, THEN, ELSE)
       ... </k>
       <env> L:Int </env>
       <scopes>
         ... L |-> scope(
           "brackets" |-> _BRACKETS:Val
           "depth" |-> _D:Int
           "bracket" |-> str(iCons(C:Int, .IntSeq)),
           _PARENT:Parent) ...
       </scopes>
       requires C ==Int 60
       [priority(40)]

operational_rules.rationale: Observes a non-opening current character and routes the program's bracket equality test to the false #branch state.
operational_rules.text:
rule <k>
         If(Compare(Name("bracket"), CmpOp("==", Str("<"))),
            THEN:Stmts, ELSE:Stmts)
       =>
         #branch(false, THEN, ELSE)
       ... </k>
       <env> L:Int </env>
       <scopes>
         ... L |-> scope(
           "brackets" |-> _BRACKETS:Val
           "depth" |-> _D:Int
           "bracket" |-> str(iCons(C:Int, .IntSeq)),
           _PARENT:Parent) ...
       </scopes>
       requires C =/=Int 60
       [priority(40)]

operational_rules.rationale: Executes the concrete depth += 1 statement by updating the depth binding in the modeled local scope.
operational_rules.text:
rule <k>
         AugAssign(Name("depth"), "+", Int(1)) => .K
       ... </k>
       <env> L:Int </env>
       <scopes>
         ... L |-> scope(
           "brackets" |-> _BRACKETS:Val
           "depth" |-> (D:Int => D +Int 1)
           "bracket" |-> _BRACKET:Val,
           _PARENT:Parent) ...
       </scopes>
       [priority(40)]

operational_rules.rationale: Executes function-frame popping in the verification model, restoring the continuation and caller state while normalizing deletion of the fresh scope.
operational_rules.text:
rule <k> #pop => V ~> CONT </k>
       <ret> retV(V:Val) => noRet </ret>
       <stack>
         ListItem(frame(CONT:K, CALLER:Int, SAVED:Int)) REST:List => REST
       </stack>
       <env> L:Int => CALLER </env>
       <scopes> (L |-> _FRAME:Scope SC:Map) => SC </scopes>
       <scopeLoc> _ => SAVED </scopeLoc>
       requires notBool L in_keys(SC)
       [priority(40)]
